slots.name: positions examined
slots.sentence: With over 3,000 top positions examined across twelve sectors over a long period of time, the Elitenmonitor study, conducted by the universities of Jena (Thuringia), Leipzig (Saxony), and Zittau/Görlitz (Saxony), can offer more than just a snapshot.

slots.name: leadership representation
slots.sentence: And in the business and cultural sectors, the percentage of East Germans has actually declined.

slots.name: largest companies count
slots.sentence: East Germans are also severely underrepresented in top positions in the judiciary and the media.

slots.name: general leadership representation percentage
slots.sentence: According to the report, the percentage of East Germans in leadership positions in both the public and private sectors only increased from 10.9% to 12.1% from 2018 to 2024.
